text: Ombudsman Toronto’s housing unit is a dedicated team overseeing the fairness of the City of Toronto’s housing policies and programs. Luke Brown, Acting Deputy Ombudsman (Housing) will present their work, which includes: - conducting systems reviews and systemic investigations into the planning and delivery of Toronto’s housing services and program; - monitoring the implementation of the City’s housing policy from a human rights and fairness perspective; and - engaging meaningfully with individuals and communities facing housing precarity.
The Housing Rights Advisory Committee received the item for information.
